verses.text: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you how God will punish the great prostitute who sits by many waters.
The kings of the earth did sexual sin with her, and the people who live on the earth became drunk on the wine of her sexual sin."

Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a desert. There I saw a woman sitting on a bright red beast. The beast was covered with names that insulted God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
The woman was dressed in purple and bright red, and she was covered with gold, jewels, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup full of disgusting things and the filth of her sexual sin.
On her forehead a name was written, a name with a secret meaning: "BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE DISGUSTING THINGS OF THE EARTH."
I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God's holy people, the blood of those who died for telling about Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly amazed.
Then the angel said to me, "Why are you amazed? I will explain to you the secret of the woman and of the beast she rides, the one with seven heads and ten horns.

The beast you saw was once alive, but now it is not. It is about to come up out of the bottomless pit and go to its destruction. The people who live on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life since the world was made, will be amazed when they see the beast. It was, and now is not, and yet it will come.
This calls for a wise mind. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.
They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is ruling now, and the other has not yet come. When he does come, he must stay only a short time.
The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king. It belongs with the seven, and it is going to its destruction.
The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet started to rule. But they will be given authority as kings for one hour, together with the beast.
They all have one purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
They will make war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will win against them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings. And with him will be those he has called and chosen, his faithful followers."
Then the angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.
The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her ruined and naked. They will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.
For God has put it into their hearts to carry out his plan. They will agree to give their kingdom to the beast, until what God has said comes true.
The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth."
